newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines sees higher coconut output, exports.
newsitem.headline: Philippines sees higher coconut output, exports.

text.p: The Philippines expects to a coconut crop of 2.7 million tonnes of year, up from an estimated 2.2 million tonnes last year, Philippine Coconut Authority (PCA) administrator Virgilio David said on Friday.

David told a news conference that the higher output was due to relatively good weather in 1996. Coconut production was badly hit in 1996 due to a series of typhoons which hit growing areas in late 1995, he said.
David added that coconut production is projected to reach 3.6 million tonnes by the year 2000.
He also said that the government had alloted 4.0 billion pesos to enhance the productivity of coconut farmers.
Out of the projected output, David said the country would export 1.6 to 1.7 million tonnes of coconut products this year worth more than $1.1 billion.
Last year, the industry exported 1.457 million tonnes of coconut products worth $845.5 million.
